exposure: Depth of placenta invading the uterine muscle wall (placenta adhesion, implantation, penetration)
Clinical and placental ultrasound imaging performed prior to delivery
outcome: Severe postpartum hemorrhage (defined as exceeding 1,500 mL)
cohort: The study included patients with placenta previa from a single center whose data was retrospectively analyzed to establish a predictive risk model for severe postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: The study established a predictive risk model for severe postpartum hemorrhage in patients with placenta previa, identifying maternal age, times of delivery, time of miscarriage, history of vaginal delivery, gestational weeks at pregnancy termination, and depth of placental invasion as independent risk factors, with the model showing high decision accuracy.
gest_age: Variable, including patients at <37 weeks and >=37 weeks at pregnancy termination
